title.zh: 提高菲律宾武装部队士兵月度基本薪金的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Monthly Base Pay of Soldiers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Monthly Base Pay of Soldiers of the Armed Forces of the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6104_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section four of Republic Act Numbered Eighteen hundred thirty-one, otherwise known as the "Enlisted Men's Pay and Allowance Act of nineteen hundred fifty-seven,” as amended by Republic Act Numbered Thirty-four hundred and sixty, is further amended to read as follows:
"Section 4. The monthly base pay of enlisted personnel of the Regular Force shall not be less than the following:
"(a) E-7 (₱175.00) - ₱260.00 "(b) E-6 (165.00) - 240.00 "(c) E-5 (155.00) - 220.00 "(d) E-4 (145.00) - 205.00 "(e) E-3 (140.00) - 195.00 "(f) E-2 (135.00) - 185.00 “(g) E-l (130.00) - 180.00"

There is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of fifty million pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary to implement the provisions of this Act for the fiscal year ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and seventy. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for the same purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
